```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(simtrait)
library(gdata)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Load data (with metacorr_lambda column)
```{r}
samafs_df <- read.table("/home/tt207/cryptic-relatedness/samafs_inflation_factor_data_metacorr.txt", header = TRUE)
samafs_df$data <- "SAMAFS"

hchs_sol_df <- read.table("/home/tt207/cryptic-relatedness/hchs-sol-inflation_factor_data_metacorr.txt", header = TRUE)
hchs_sol_df$data <- "HCHS/SOL"

df <- rbind(samafs_df, hchs_sol_df)
df$data <- factor(df$data, levels = c("SAMAFS", "HCHS/SOL"))
```

# Reshape for faceting: two rows (sex-meta, sex-meta-corr) x two columns (dataset)
```{r}
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(meta_lambda, metacorr_lambda),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "y_lambda"
  ) %>%
  mutate(method = case_when(
    method == "meta_lambda" ~ "sex-meta",
    method == "metacorr_lambda" ~ "sex-meta-corr"
  ))

df_long$method <- factor(df_long$method,
                         levels = c("sex-meta",
                                    "sex-meta-corr"))
```

# Combined figure: 2 rows x 2 columns
```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
fig <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = joint_lambda, y = y_lambda)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.05,
             linetype = "solid", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.05,
             linetype = "solid", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(method), cols = vars(data)) +
  labs(
    x = "Joint analysis inflation factor",
    y = "Sex-stratified meta-analysis inflation factor"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_equal() +
  xlim(c(0.95, 1.2)) +
  ylim(c(0.95, 1.2)) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

fig

ggsave(
  filename = "realdata_inflation_metacorr.pdf",
  plot = fig,
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```
